`enum VertexComponent`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.vertex` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [VertexComponent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/vertex/VertexComponent.java)

The numeric type of the components of a vertex attribute.

## Description

[`VertexAttribute`](/reference/pipeline/vertexattribute/) gives each attribute one of these types; a backend maps it to the vertex format of its API.
